sentences.japanese: お互いを信頼し合うしかない。
sentences.english: All you can do is trust one another.

sentences.japanese: 近い将来、テレビ電話でお互いに意志疎通ができるようになるだろう。
sentences.english: Before long, we'll be able to communicate with each other by T.V. telephone.

sentences.japanese: 共同事業の始め方について彼らは互いに話し合いがついた。
sentences.english: They came to terms with each other on how to start a joint venture.

sentences.japanese: 去る者は日々に疎しだな。お互いに離ればなれになると、自然と疎遠になるよね。
sentences.english: Out of sight out of mind. When you're separated you lose touch.

sentences.japanese: 議論した後、彼らは互いに１週間も口をきかなかった。
sentences.english: After they argued, they didn't speak to each other for a week.
